opportunities.title: Agent identity governance ownership study
opportunities.question: Which executive role owns agent inventory, credentials, authorization policy, incident response, and budget?
opportunities.method: Role-tagged survey plus follow-up interviews with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, GCs, CFOs, and board directors.
opportunities.minimum_design: State respondent counts by role; separate operators from vendors and advisors; publish instrument and denominators.
opportunities.independence_controls: Disclose OFF recruitment, event participation, sponsorship, and advisory relationships; sponsors may not shape questions or analysis.

opportunities.title: Agent authorization implementation registry
opportunities.question: Which identity and delegated-authorization patterns are deployed, at what scale, and with what failure modes?
opportunities.method: Structured operator case series with architecture, scale, incident, revocation, audit, and interoperability fields.
opportunities.minimum_design: At least 12 deployments across 6 organizations and 3 industries; include negative and abandoned implementations.
opportunities.independence_controls: No pay-to-include entries; vendor claims remain attributed until independently checked.

opportunities.title: Human approval and monitoring burden study
opportunities.question: Where do human approval, hard limits, automated monitoring, and shutdown controls work or fail?
opportunities.method: Prospective workflow study measuring approval frequency, override rates, response time, false positives, missed events, and user burden.
opportunities.minimum_design: Pre-registered outcomes and task-risk strata; preserve unsuccessful results.
opportunities.independence_controls: Independent statistical review and privacy assessment.

opportunities.title: Benchmark-to-production validity study
opportunities.question: Do agent-security benchmark results predict production incidents or control effectiveness?
opportunities.method: Map benchmark tasks and defenses to anonymized production incidents and red-team exercises.
opportunities.minimum_design: Multiple models, agent architectures, industries, and time-stamped versions; report denominators and uncertainty.
opportunities.independence_controls: Separate benchmark authors, vendors, and evaluating operators where possible.
